name: Orforglipron

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: An investigational orally available small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for type 2 diabetes and obesity. No marketing authorisation exists.

systems.note: GLP-1 receptor agonism; the intended metabolic target.
Small-molecule oral agent with first-pass hepatic exposure and no marketed safety record.
Trial weight loss includes a lean-mass component.

monitors.why: Oral small molecule without a post-marketing hepatic record.
